    LUDO-T API documentation

    Packages
    Package
    Description
    Unnamed Package
     
    config.constant
    Named constants of the game rules and of the board layout, so the code has no magic numbers.
    config.enums
    Enumerations shared by the whole game: colours, piece locations, coin toss results, effect types and blockade types.
    controller
    Starts and runs the game.
    exception
    The custom runtime exceptions of the game, for illegal moves and invalid states.
    message
    The marker interface of all game messages.
    message.cannotmove
    Messages that explain why a piece or a block cannot move.
    message.capture
    Messages about captures of pieces and of blockades.
    message.game
    Messages about the game as a whole: the start, the rounds, the board state, the roster of pieces and the final standings.
    message.move
    Messages about moves, entering the board, direction changes and reaching Home.
    message.mystery
    Messages about the Mystery Cell: its appearance, its teleports, its effects and the Beta restriction.
    message.observer
    The Observer pattern for game messages: the publisher, the registry, the observer and the message centre that connects them.
    message.toss
    Messages of the toss that decides who plays first.
    message.turn
    Messages about the turns of the players: the start of a turn, the rolls and the home gate.
    model.board
     
    model.board.cell
     
    model.direction
    The two directions of movement, clockwise and counter-clockwise (Strategy pattern), and the coin toss that gives a piece its direction.
    model.effect.activation
    Rules that decide whether the effect of a Mystery Cell destination may start (Chain of Responsibility).
    model.effect.destination
    The six destinations to which a Mystery Cell can teleport pieces: Alpha, Beta, Gamma, Base, Entry and Approach.
    model.effect.movement
    Movement effects of pieces: Energized and Sick.
    model.effect.mysterycell
    The Mystery Cell: where it stands, when it appears and moves, and the contract of its destinations.
    model.effect.restriction
    Movement restrictions of a piece, such as the Beta restriction (State pattern).
    model.effect.rule
    Rules that apply the effects of a Mystery Cell: the Alpha effect and the Gamma direction rule.
    model.piece
    The game piece and helpers that name a group of pieces or measure the distance to Home.
    model.player
    The players and the policy that decides when a piece may enter its HomeStraight.
    model.player.command
    The base interfaces of the Command pattern: every action of the game, such as a move or a capture, is a command.
    model.player.command.cannotmove
    Commands that only announce why a piece or a block cannot move.
    model.player.command.capture
    Commands that capture a piece or a blockade.
    model.player.command.move
    Commands that move pieces or blockades, break a blockade, or bring a piece out of Base.
    model.player.command.mystery
    Commands for the Mystery Cell: the teleport and the return to Base of a Beta-restricted piece.
    model.player.rule.block
    Rules about blockades: limits in front of opponent blockades, sharing the roll of a blockade, and breaking a blockade on a third six.
    model.player.rule.capture
    Rules that find captures of pieces and of blockades (Chain of Responsibility).
    model.player.rule.home
    Rules about the HomeStraight and Home: the conditions to enter it, the home gate and the exact roll.
    model.player.rule.mystery
    Rules about the Mystery Cell and the Beta restriction.
    model.player.rule.roll
    Rules about the roll of a turn, such as the void third six.
    model.player.rule.turn
    Turn rules that list the legal commands for a roll: entering the board and moving pieces.
    model.player.strategy
    The rule-based AI (Strategy pattern): how a player chooses one command out of the legal commands.
    model.player.strategy.blockdirection
    The direction in which a blockade travels: the strategy and the classification of a blockade.
    model.player.strategy.helper
    Helpers shared by the strategies: the rotation of Blue, the capture finder and the command finder.
    model.player.strategy.playstyle
    The play styles of the four colours: Red, Yellow, Green and Blue, and the default style.
    model.round
    Reaction to the start and the end of a round.
    model.rule
    The base class of every Chain of Responsibility in the game.
    utils.coin
    The coin toss and its display text.
    utils.color
    The display text of a colour.
    utils.dice
    The die of the game.
    utils.randomgenerator
    The seeded random number generator that makes every game repeatable.
    view
    The console view: the observer that prints game messages and the catalogue of presenters.
    view.presenter
    The base classes and helpers that turn a game message into console text.
    view.presenter.cannotmove
    Presenters for the cannot-move messages.
    view.presenter.capture
    Presenters for the capture messages.
    view.presenter.game
    Presenters for the game messages: start, rounds, roster, board state and final standings.
    view.presenter.move
    Presenters for the move messages.
    view.presenter.mystery
    Presenters for the Mystery Cell messages.
    view.presenter.toss
    Presenters for the toss messages.
    view.presenter.turn
    Presenters for the turn messages.
